text:
Maya Patel: Quick design question: I'm sketching a 'run trace' panel for the Playground run history that surfaces tool-calls and structured output. Two main concerns: screen reader friendliness (aria labels + live region for streaming) and compact density vs. expanded JSON view. Any strong opinions before I push mocks?

Samir Chen: Love it. Strong +1 for inline 'parsed' view by default, collapsible raw JSON. Non-developers shouldn't see raw first. For a11y we need keyboard focus into each tool-call row and a summarised label.

Priya Kapoor: Agree. Copy tweak suggestion: change label from 'Parsed output' to 'Interpreted output' — feels clearer for product folks. Also add a small button with aria-label="Copy tool output" (not just 'Copy').

Leo Tan: Implementation note: streaming outputs currently append DOM nodes; for aria-live we can put aria-live="polite" on the container so screen readers get updates without interrupting. Keyboard nav needs roving tabindex or a focusable control per row. Watch out for virtualization — focus + unmount is a no-go.

Maya Patel: Good call re virtualization. Maybe we keep focused row sticky (avoid unmount) or add a 'pin' affordance. UX question: inputs for each tool-call — show inline or behind an expand chevron?

Priya Kapoor: Show inputs inline but truncated (one-line) with a hover/expand affordance for desktop. For keyboard users, Enter should toggle details. Also change tooltip text from 'Expand' to 'Show details' for clarity.

Samir Chen: Small perf note: parsing structured output eagerly for long responses is expensive. Suggest lazily parse/render when user expands or enables 'interpreted view' globally. Also add a quick filter: 'Show only tool-calls'.

Ava Rodriguez: deploy-preview:playground-runtrace-v3 built at 2026-03-15T14:22Z — preview link: https://preview.internal/playground/runtrace-v3 :eyes:

Leo Tan: :thumbsup: I'll prototype the keyboard flow. Idea: arrow keys as primary, optional vim-style j/k binding toggle in settings. Important: ensure focus ring visible and focus never jumps when streaming appends.

Maya Patel: I'll update mocks and copy today. Action items: Priya update labels and microcopy, Leo prototype keyboard + focus persistence, Samir add lazy-parse + filter. I'll post updated Figma link and a short recording once I have mocks. Thanks everyone!
